verdict: Southern Company profit rose 20% to $2.0B as warmer weather, customer growth and large data-center-style loads lifted Southeast electricity sales 7% and revenue 13%.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: operating revenues $8,843M vs $7,823M a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted; vs $1.54 a year ago (basic $1.77 vs $1.55)

kpis.label: Adjusted EPS
kpis.note: excluding repowering, debt-extinguishment and other flagged items

segments.name: Retail electricity — non-fuel
segments.note: The base price households and businesses pay for electricity, excluding fuel pass-through — the largest line, up 16% on rates, usage and customer growth.

segments.name: Retail electricity — fuel
segments.note: Fuel costs passed through to retail customers — up 18% with generation and fuel prices.

segments.name: Wholesale electricity
segments.note: Power sold to other utilities and markets — up 5%.

segments.name: Natural gas
segments.note: Gas distribution to homes and businesses in four states — up 5%.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Distributed energy, fiber, telecom and other services — up 20%.

opex.name: Operations & maintenance
opex.note: Non-fuel cost of running power plants, wires and gas networks — up on growth and storm and service work.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of power plants and grids over their lives; includes $118M of accelerated charges for wind repowering.

takeaways.title: The Southeast is booming
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 13% to $8,843M. Retail electricity sales rose 7.7%, with commercial sales up 10.1% on large customers — management calls Southeast growth 'unprecedented and transformational'.

takeaways.title: Adjusted profit beat the headline
takeaways.text: Excluding flagged items, EPS was $1.94 versus GAAP diluted EPS of $1.76. The gap is mainly $118M of accelerated wind-repowering depreciation and debt-extinguishment costs.

takeaways.title: Interest is the big drag below the line
takeaways.text: Interest expense of $842M — funding a huge build-out of generation and grid — was partly offset by $140M of allowance for funds used during construction and $77M of equity earnings.

oneTimers: $118M pre-tax accelerated depreciation and decommissioning for repowering Southern Power wind facilities ($92M after tax).
$43M of debt-extinguishment costs, plus a $57M change in related tax benefits, and a $9M estimated loss on disallowed Nicor Gas capital investments.
otherDetail: Other income of -$454M is interest expense of $842M, partly offset by $140M allowance for equity funds used during construction, $77M of earnings from equity investments and $171M of other income.
footerNote: Consolidated net income was $2,074M; $28M belonged to noncontrolling interests, leaving $2,046M attributable to Southern Company common shareholders.
